page.overview:
Who is Alexandra Gianopoulos?

Alexandra Gianopoulo was a Greek heiress.

Her father was killed by Emperor Aquaman during his invasion of Europe. She helped Booster Gold in fighting the Project Superman weapon known as Subject Six (Doomsday).
